scope.goal: Separate prospective completion payloads, actual validation receipts, and custody release without fabricating a pass.
constraints: Bind candidate and receipt by exact bytes.
Preserve failed, blocked, and interrupted delivery facts.
Do not treat the historical exception as a normal flow.

user_constraints: Keep package impact truthful and run no unrelated matrices.

finding_evidence: The completion record asserted a validator result before that validator could read it.
Independent immutable-head audit reproduced an unvalidated candidate schema assertion and unsafe or unbound receipt artifact references.
A fixed-head independent audit found that a Windows alternate-data-stream receipt target could pass custody validation before the pre-send ignore check.

steps: Replace circular assertion with a receipt bound to candidate bytes.
Validate delivery and custody release without reclassifying outcomes.
Harden candidate-field closure and receipt artifact custody against the independent audit reproductions.
Reject Windows alternate-data-stream custody paths found by fixed-head audit B1.
execution.commit_checkpoint: Commit the #310 fixed-head audit B1 remediation after focused validation.
deferred_items: Normal future package planning and any downstream adoption.

results.summary: Replaced the prospective self-pass assertion with a completion candidate, independently written receipt, exact-byte custody binding, and terminal delivery verification; then hardened it to reject candidate self-assertions, unsafe or unbound artifact references, argv drift, receipt overwrite, and Windows alternate-data-stream paths.

test_execution.summary: 22 focused tests passed in 13.234s, including self-assertion rejection, actual ignored-root custody, unsafe and unbound refs, exact writer argv binding, receipt overwrite refusal, Windows alternate-data-stream rejection, post-validation mutation, and non-passing custody release.
Schema v1.2 validation passed; custody remains held until a matching receipt is verified.

validation_evidence: No actual external task was dispatched; focused tests are supporting contract evidence only and do not relabel the historical blocked outer receipt.
The initial independent audit reproductions now fail closed in focused negative tests.
Fixed-head audit B1 is locally addressed by negative coverage; a fresh independent audit is still required before admission.
